about: The definitive edition of the Atelier "Mysterious" series at a new price, with brand new content and various DLCs! "Atelier Sophie" is the 1st instalment: a chance encounter between Sophie and a sentient book Plachta takes them on an adventure to recover Plachta's memories.
summary: The definitive edition of the Atelier "Mysterious" series at a new price, with brand new content and various DLCs!
